facts.text: Ohio University's all-in Tuition and Fees Guarantee locks in rates for housing, dining and fees for 12 consecutive semesters.
Ohio University requires students to live on campus for their first two years of academic study.
The OHIO Guarantee locks in level rates for tuition, housing, and dining for students pursuing an undergraduate degree.
